content: Hi how can i assist you today
The GPS blue dot drifts into shapes that look like initials I’m thinking about.
Blue-dot drift comes from signal quality and multipath reflections. Were you indoors, under trees, or near tall buildings when it traced those shapes?
Indoors next to a window downtown.
That’s where drift is common. A short screen recording inside vs. in an open plaza can show more drift indoors and a steadier dot outside.
I’ll try an outdoor recording for comparison.
Side-by-side clips often make the signal-quality difference obvious.
